title: A longer stress signal
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Cortisol is a glucocorticoid released by the adrenal cortex and participates in metabolic and stress responses. Its effects depend on context.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which glucocorticoid hormone is released by the adrenal cortex and helps regulate metabolism during stress? Cortisol is a glucocorticoid released by the adrenal cortex and participates in metabolic and stress responses. Its effects depend on context.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.
